mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wms_env_data (device_id, online, temperature, humidity, collect_time, receive_time) VALUES
( #{item.deviceId}, #{item.online}, #{item.temperature}, #{item.humidity}, #{item.collectTime}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.device_id, d.online, d.temperature, d.humidity, d.collect_time, d.receive_time, c.device_name, c.warehouse, c.device_type, c.location FROM wms_env_data d LEFT JOIN wms_env_device c ON c.device_id = d.device_id WHERE d.id = ( SELECT d2.id FROM wms_env_data d2 WHERE d2.device_id = d.device_id ORDER BY d2.collect_time DESC, d2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY d.device_id
